mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of a saltwater swimming pool system?

acceptedAnswer.text: Saltwater swimming pool systems offer several benefits compared to traditional chlorine pools. They use a salt chlorine generator to convert dissolved salt into chlorine, resulting in a softer, gentler water feel that is less irritating to skin and eyes. This system typically requires less manual handling of harsh chemicals and can lead to lower ongoing chemical costs. While the initial setup cost might be higher, many homeowners find the enhanced swimming experience and reduced maintenance efforts to be worthwhile benefits.
acceptedAnswer.description: Saltwater pools offer softer water, are less irritating to skin and eyes, and require less manual chemical handling than traditional chlorine pools, often leading to lower ongoing chemical costs.
